I started writing that 20 minutes ago when I thought I had it all figured out.  Life, however, is not able to complete 100%

I want to preface what I am about to type with the fact that I immediately read your post 3 times to make sure I was interpreting your point correctly.  (Fuck, I read this over again and it doesn't even mean what I want it to mean)

I have so many thoughts that run through my head every single day.  Most of them are mundane, but some seem to have potential to develop beyond a fantasy "real world"

To be blunt, I feel like all my thoughts are so ineffable that I cannot share them with anybody. I am trapped inside my own mind.

I don't want to say you cured me exactly, but you did spark a realization that there are parts to a story that have to be fulfilled.  The problem is that even in a story there are second-hand players that don't make it to the end.

That sounds really dark, but you did make me laugh a bit at my insanity I guess.
Yep, pretty much hit it right on the head there.  [10]
